cat > /home/user/setup_env.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

input=/home/user/legacy_users.txt
output=/home/user/hardened_users.txt
tmp=$(mktemp "${output}.tmp.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT

awk -F: 'NF != 3 { exit 1 } { if ($2 != "wheel") $3 = "/usr/sbin/nologin"; print $1 ":" $2 ":" $3 }' "$input" > "$tmp"
chmod 0444 "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" "$output"
trap - EXIT
EOF

cat > /home/user/start_vm.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
exec qemu-system-x86_64 -m 512 -hda /home/user/disk.qcow2 -nographic -vnc 127.0.0.1:2,password=on
EOF
chmod 0755 /home/user/setup_env.sh /home/user/start_vm.sh
/home/user/setup_env.sh

cron_tmp=$(mktemp)
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null || :) > "$cron_tmp"
if ! grep -Fqx '15 3 * * * /home/user/setup_env.sh' "$cron_tmp"; then
  printf '%s\n' '15 3 * * * /home/user/setup_env.sh' >> "$cron_tmp"
fi
crontab "$cron_tmp"
rm -f "$cron_tmp"

printf '%s\n' '--- hardened_users.txt ---'
cat /home/user/hardened_users.txt
printf '%s\n' '--- permissions ---'
stat -c '%a %n' /home/user/setup_env.sh /home/user/start_vm.sh /home/user/hardened_users.txt
printf '%s\n' '--- start_vm.sh ---'
cat /home/user/start_vm.sh
printf '%s\n' '--- root crontab ---'
crontab -l
